author: attenboroughac
title: Paid mural painter for exhibition wall
content: Open Call: Painting a mural for an exhibition at Attenborough Arts Centre. Jemisha Maadhavji is looking for artist/s to paint a floral wallpaper mural on one 10m wall. Open to all including students and recent graduates. Need a painter confident following floral pattern references, comfortable with acrylics, able to complete within the timeframe. Commission fee £750. Materials provided. Duration 3 days: 28–30 September 2026. Location: Attenborough Arts Centre, Leicester. Send short bio explaining suitability, portfolio and examples or website/Instagram to jemishamaadhavji7@gmail.com and Cc mybc1@leicester.ac.uk by 21 September 2026.

author: neal_illustrator
title: Hiring artists for comic and animation teams
content: Heyo! I’m doing an all call looking for artists to help build out my comic and animation teams! I think it’s time to try and ease up some of the stress and expand my team! I’m excited to see y’all’s portfolios! Application Links are in my linktree (in bio). Stay stellar!!

author: harrier_studio
title: Harrier Studio hiring illustrators and comic artists
content: HARRIER STUDIO IS HIRING! Open positions: Illustrator (Full Stage), Sketch Artist (Drafter), Line Artist, Colorist, Compositor, Storyboard Artist, Styling Artist, Typesetter. Looking for people who are serious, consistent, and can work with a team. Send CV & Portfolio to harrierstdrecruitment@gmail.com (Subject: Nama – Posisi – CV & Portofolio). Open until all positions are filled.
